key_idea: Count the squares and the triangles in each drawing.
steps: A: 3 squares, 1 triangle. B: 2 squares, 2 triangles.
C: 1 square, 3 triangles. D: 4 squares, 2 triangles. E: 2 squares, 1 triangle.
Only C has fewer squares than triangles: 1 is less than 3.

choice_feedback.A: It has 3 squares and only 1 triangle, so it has more squares.
choice_feedback.B: It has 2 squares and 2 triangles, the same number.
choice_feedback.D: It has 4 squares and 2 triangles, so it has more squares.
choice_feedback.E: It has 2 squares and 1 triangle, so it has more squares.
